name: Crude Oil EIA Inventory Reaction
description: Measures crude oil's average absolute price move at 1, 5, 15, and 30 minutes after the weekly EIA Petroleum Status Report (Wednesdays 10:30 ET). Uses day_of_week + time_of_day proxy for EIA release detection on 1-minute CL futures bars.
source:
# Crude Oil EIA Inventory Report Reaction Study
# Measures average absolute move at +1, +5, +15, +30 min after 10:30 ET Wednesday release
# Uses day_of_week + time_of_day proxy (no FRED calendar for EIA)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c

# --- EIA Release Detection ---
# EIA Petroleum Status Report: every Wednesday at 10:30 ET
is_wed = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Wednesday)().result
bar_tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(index()).value
is_1030 = bar_tod == 630  # 10:30 ET = 10*60 + 30 = 630 minutes from midnight
is_eia_bar = is_wed and is_1030

# --- Forward Absolute Moves (% of price at release) ---
# Use << (lead) to get future close, compute absolute % change
abs_move_1m  = where(is_eia_bar, abs((close << 1) - close) / close)
abs_move_5m  = where(is_eia_bar, abs((close << 5) - close) / close)
abs_move_15m = where(is_eia_bar, abs((close << 15) - close) / close)
abs_move_30m = where(is_eia_bar, abs((close << 30) - close) / close)

# --- Output: Bar chart of average absolute move by horizon ---
# Sparse data (one value per Wednesday) → xy_bars with Mean agg (R12)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='How Much Does Crude Move After EIA?',
    category='EIA Reaction',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 Min', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 Min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+15 Min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30 Min', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(abs_move_1m, abs_move_5m, abs_move_15m, abs_move_30m))

# --- Event markers for each EIA release ---
# Signed move at +5 min as hero metric (captures the initial reaction direction)
signed_move_5m = where(is_eia_bar, ((close << 5) - close) / close)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EIA Inventory Release',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='+5m Move', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='+30m Move', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(signed_move_5m, close, where(is_eia_bar, ((close << 30) - close) / close), is_eia_bar)
